meetings.title: Hosted at Capital Group symposium
meetings.summary: The meeting focused on discussing the Stonebridge Health System Operating Fund's current status and potential strategies for improvement. The attendees explored various options, including a potential reallocation of funds to other investment vehicles managed by Capital Group.

decisions.text: Stonebridge Health System Operating Fund will be considered for a reallocation of funds to other Capital Group-managed vehicles.

action_items.text: Develop a detailed retention plan for Stonebridge Health System Operating Fund.
Present the retention plan to the Investment Committee at their next meeting.

transcript_excerpt.speaker: Aisha Lindqvist
transcript_excerpt.text: I think we should consider reallocating some of Stonebridge Health System Operating Fund's funds to other Capital Group-managed vehicles. What do you all think?
